name: Madera Equity
headline: A digital platform for a multifamily property investment firm
overview: Madera Equity invests in and manages multifamily communities across Texas and the wider Sun Belt, and treats technology as part of how it creates value. Techlio built its digital platform from discovery and design through development, deployment and support: the public site that presents strategy, markets, performance, case studies and insights, with automated content and enquiry workflows and dashboards for the team.

metrics.label: communities acquired by Madera, per its site

solutions.title: Investor-facing platform
solutions.text: Strategy, market focus, performance, case studies, team and insights presented in a fast, structured site with a clear route to get in touch or reach investor access.

solutions.title: Performance and market views
solutions.text: Portfolio figures and market coverage shown as clear data views that the team can update without a developer.

solutions.title: Automated content and enquiry workflows
solutions.text: Insights publishing and enquiry routing run as automated workflows, so new research goes live and new contacts reach the right person.

solutions.title: Dashboards for the team
solutions.text: Dashboards that bring together enquiries and engagement so the team can see what investors are reading and asking about.

solutions.title: Security built in
solutions.text: Techlio's security baseline applied from the first sprint: OWASP-based secure coding and review, role-based access control, encryption in transit and at rest, least-privilege access to cloud resources and vulnerability scans before each release. For Madera that covers hardened forms, consent-based cookies and analytics, and strict separation from third-party investor systems.
